notes.title: First Demo Version avaliable play now!!!
notes.notes:
🎮 The Guild of Hunters demo is now available on Steam!

Get ready to face dangerous creatures, make tactical decisions, and lead your guild through thrilling turn-based battles!

This is just the beginning of a grand story filled with magic, mysteries, and pixel art action.

🧭 Recruit, fight, and grow stronger.
🛡️ Assemble your team, unlock new abilities, and take down powerful bosses.
🎯 Every move counts every step brings you closer to triumph.

👉 Click "Play" and start your journey now!
